Organisation Organ

Class

A group that (i) is part of an organisation, (ii) it serves a specific function in the organisation in question, and (iii) it not itself an organisation

Note

The difference between an organisation organ and an organisation that is part of another organisation is that the official goals of an organ are entirely subordinated to those of the organisation of which it is part; by contrast, an organisation can maintain its own goals despite being part of a larger organisation
